translations.literal: Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong

sentences.zh: 山東：禹貢青、徐及兗、豫四州之域。

translations.literal: Shandong: the territory of the four provinces Qing, Xu, Yan, and Yu in the Tribute of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong lay within the domains of the Qing, Xu, Yan, and Yu regions described in the Tribute of Yu.

sentences.zh: 明置山東承宣布政使司。

translations.literal: The Ming established the Shandong Provincial Administration Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it was organized as the Shandong Provincial Administration Commission.

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Qing it was continued unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: The early Qing retained this arrangement.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，升濟南府之泰安、武定、濱，兗州府之濟寧、曹、沂等六州為直隸州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, the six departments Tai'an, Wuding, and Bin of Jinan Prefecture and Jining, Cao, and Yi of Yanzhou Prefecture were promoted to directly administered departments.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 (1724), six departments—Tai'an, Wuding, and Bin under Jinan Prefecture and Jining, Cao, and Yi under Yanzhou Prefecture—were elevated to directly administered status.

sentences.zh: 八年，濟寧州仍屬兗州府。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Jining Department was again made subordinate to Yanzhou Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 8, Jining was again placed under Yanzhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二年，升武定、沂二州為府，濱州改屬武定。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Wuding and Yi Departments were promoted to prefectures, and Bin Department was reassigned to Wuding.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 12, Wuding and Yi were raised to prefectural rank, and Bin was transferred to Wuding's jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 十三年，升泰安、曹二州為府。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Tai'an and Cao Departments were promoted to prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13, Tai'an and Cao were likewise elevated to prefectures.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年，仍升濟寧、臨清為直隸州。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Qianlong, Jining and Linqing were again promoted to directly administered departments.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41 (1776), Jining and Linqing were once more made directly administered departments.

sentences.zh: 凡領府十，州二，散州八，縣九十六。

translations.idiomatic: In total the province comprised ten prefectures, two directly administered departments, eight subordinate departments, and ninety-six counties.

translations.idiomatic: It lay to the south of the capital.

translations.idiomatic: To the east it reached the sea;

translations.idiomatic: Two hundred forty li.

translations.literal: Its width was one thousand six hundred forty li and its length eight hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured one thousand six hundred forty li from east to west and eight hundred li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高三十四度三十五分至三十八度二十分。

translations.literal: North polar altitude ranged from thirty-four degrees thirty-five minutes to thirty-eight degrees twenty minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude ranged from 34°35′ to 38°20′ north.

sentences.zh: 京師偏西一度二十五分至偏東六度四十分。

translations.literal: Relative to the capital it lay from one degree twenty-five minutes west to six degrees forty minutes east.
translations.idiomatic: Relative to the capital it lay from 1°25′ west to 6°40′ east in longitude.

sentences.zh: 宣統三年，編戶五百三十七萬七千八百七十二，口三千一百三萬六千九百四十四。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuantong, registered households numbered five million three hundred seventy-seven thousand eight hundred seventy-two and population thirty-one million three hundred six thousand nine hundred forty-four.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3 (1911) there were 5,377,872 registered households and a population of 31,306,944.

translations.literal: Jinan Prefecture: strategic, busy, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Jinan Prefecture: rated strategic, commercially busy, and difficult to govern.

sentences.zh: 巡撫，布政、提學、提法、鹽運司，濟東泰武臨、巡警、勸業道駐。

translations.literal: The governor, the provincial administration, education, judicial, and salt transport commissioners, and the Jidong Taiwu Lin, patrol, and promotion-of-industry intendancies were stationed here.
translations.idiomatic: It was the seat of the provincial governor and of the administration, education, judicial, and salt-transport commissioners, as well as the Jidong Taiwu Lin, patrol, and promotion-of-industry intendancies.

sentences.zh: 初沿明制為省治，領州四，縣二十六。

translations.literal: At first, following the Ming system, it served as the provincial capital and governed four departments and twenty-six counties.
translations.idiomatic: Originally, following Ming practice, it served as the provincial capital and governed four departments and twenty-six counties.

sentences.zh: 雍正中，武定、泰安、濱直隸，割陽信、萊蕪、利津等九縣屬之。

translations.literal: During the Yongzheng period Wuding, Tai'an, and Bin became directly administered, and nine counties including Yangxin, Laiwu, and Lijin were detached to them.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng reign Wuding, Tai'an, and Bin were made directly administered departments, and nine counties—including Yangxin, Laiwu, and Lijin—were transferred to their jurisdiction.

translations.literal: To the north it was eight hundred li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lay eight hundred li north of the capital.

sentences.zh: 廣三百六十里，袤二百八十里。

translations.literal: Its width was three hundred sixty li and its length two hundred eighty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured three hundred sixty li from east to west and two hundred eighty li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高三十六度四十五分。

translations.literal: North polar altitude was thirty-six degrees forty-five minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its latitude was 36°45′ north.

translations.literal: It lay forty-one minutes east of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lay 41′ east of the capital in longitude.

translations.literal: It governed one department and fifteen counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed one department and fifteen counties.

translations.literal: Licheng: strategic, busy, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Licheng County: rated strategic, commercially busy, and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: Attached to the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It was the seat of the prefecture.

translations.literal: South of the city: Mount Li.
translations.idiomatic: To the south of the city stood Mount Li.

translations.literal: To the east: Mount Hua Bu Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: To the east stood Mount Hua Bu Zhu.

translations.literal: To the southeast: the Changcheng Range, from which the Yu River rises.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast lay the Changcheng Range, where the Yu River has its source.

sentences.zh: 錦雲川水入長清注黃河。

translations.literal: The Jinyun River enters Changqing and flows into the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinyun River passes through Changqing and joins the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 河即大清、濟水故道，其右瀆入。

translations.literal: The river is the former course of the Daqing and Ji Rivers, and its right branch enters here.
translations.idiomatic: This was the former channel of the Da Qing and Ji Rivers; the right branch of the Yellow River enters here.

sentences.zh: 西北逕藥山，北至濼口鎮。

translations.literal: To the northwest it passes Mount Yao and north reaches Luokou Town.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest it passes Mount Yao and runs north to Luokou Town.

sentences.zh: 又東北逕鵲山，其南新小清河入，逕城北，右受大明湖，東逕虞山，納巨合及關盧、武原水，併入章丘。

translations.literal: Again to the northeast it passes Mount Que; south of it the New Xiaoqing River enters, passes north of the city wall, receives Daming Lake on the right, passes east by Mount Yu, takes in the Juhe and Guanlu and Wuyuan rivers, and together enters Zhangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: Farther northeast it passes Mount Que. South of the mountain the New Xiaoqing River enters, runs along the north side of the city wall, receives Daming Lake on the right, then flows east past Mount Yu, where it absorbs the Juhe, Guanlu, and Wuyuan rivers before continuing together into Zhangqiu.

sentences.zh: 今大明湖在城內，惟匯珍珠、濯纓諸泉，乃宋西湖，非唐以前遺址矣。

translations.literal: Today Daming Lake lies within the city and only gathers the Pearl and Zhuoying springs; it is the Song-period West Lake and not a site from before the Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Today Daming Lake lies within the city walls and is fed only by springs such as Pearl Spring and Zhuoying Spring; it is the West Lake of Song times and not a remnant from before the Tang.

translations.literal: There is a patrol station: Shengongji.
translations.idiomatic: It had a patrol station at Shengongji.

translations.literal: An assistant magistrate post: Tancheng.
translations.idiomatic: An assistant magistrate was posted at Tancheng.

translations.literal: Longshan Post Station.
translations.idiomatic: It had the Longshan courier station.

translations.literal: The Jinpu and Jiaoji railways.
translations.idiomatic: The Jinpu and Jiaoji railways passed through.

translations.literal: Zhangqiu: busy, worn, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangqiu County: rated commercially busy, fiscally strained, and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: One hundred ten li east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred ten li east of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the south: Mount Changbai, Dongling, and Pingding.
translations.idiomatic: To the south stood Mount Changbai, Dongling, and Pingding.

translations.literal: To the southwest: Mount Wei;
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest stood Mount Wei;

sentences.zh: 雞山，水經注「巨合水出西北」，逕榆科泉庄，及武原、關盧水，入歷城，注新小清河。

translations.literal: Mount Ji; the Water Classic Commentary says "the Juhe River rises in the northwest," passes Yuke Spring Village and the Wuyuan and Guanlu rivers, enters Licheng, and flows into the New Xiaoqing River.
translations.idiomatic: and Mount Ji. The Water Classic Commentary states that "the Juhe River rises in the northwest"; it passes Yuke Spring Village and joins the Wuyuan and Guanlu rivers, enters Licheng, and flows into the New Xiaoqing River.

sentences.zh: 新小清復入西北，右合綉江，即溝河，注百脈水，出土鼓故城，逕陽丘故城黃巾固。

translations.literal: The New Xiaoqing again enters from the northwest, joins the Xiujiang on the right—that is, the Gou River—which flows into the Baimai River, rises at the old Tugu city, and passes the old Yangqiu city and Huangjin Fort.
translations.idiomatic: The New Xiaoqing re-enters from the northwest and on the right joins the Xiujiang—that is, the Gou River—which flows into the Baimai River. The Baimai rises at the old site of Tugu and passes the old Yangqiu city and Huangjin Fort.

sentences.zh: 小清河又東北逕賈庄入齊東。

translations.literal: The Xiaoqing River again passes northeast through Jiazhuang and enters Qidong.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiaoqing River then flows northeast through Jiazhuang and enters Qidong.

sentences.zh: 其北黃河右瀆自歷城入，緣濟陽界。

translations.literal: To its north the right branch of the Yellow River enters from Licheng and runs along the border of Jiyang.
translations.idiomatic: To its north the right branch of the Yellow River enters from Licheng and runs along the Jiyang border.

sentences.zh: 小清昔源濼水，今源獺河，別源出東南野狐嶺，西北逕青龍山，土鼓、寧戚故城，折東入鄒平，即小清故道。

translations.literal: Formerly the Xiaoqing took its source from the Luo River; today it takes the Tuo River, while a separate source rises southeast at Yehu Ridge, passes northwest by Mount Qinglong and the old cities of Tugu and Ningqi, turns east into Zouping—that is, the old course of the Xiaoqing.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Xiaoqing drew its headwaters from the Luo River; today its main source is the Tuo River, while a separate branch rises southeast at Yehu Ridge, flows northwest past Mount Qinglong and the old sites of Tugu and Ningqi, then turns east into Zouping along the former course of the Xiaoqing.

translations.literal: There is Puji Town.
translations.idiomatic: It had Puji Town.

translations.literal: Zouping: worn.
translations.idiomatic: Zouping County: rated fiscally strained.

translations.literal: One hundred sixty-five li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred sixty-five li northeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the south: Mount Changbai.
translations.idiomatic: To the south stood Mount Changbai.

translations.literal: To the southeast: Mount Huang.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast stood Mount Huang.

translations.literal: To the southwest: Jiulong.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest lay Jiulong.

sentences.zh: 北：新小清河，自齊東入，東入長山。

translations.literal: To the north: the New Xiaoqing River enters from Qidong and east enters Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the north the New Xiaoqing River enters from Qidong and flows east into Changshan.

sentences.zh: 西北：獺河，自章丘入，逕滸山濼，東北為清河溝，併入長山。

translations.literal: To the northwest: the Tuo River enters from Zhangqiu, passes Mount Hu and the Luo marsh, turns northeast as the Qinghe Channel, and together enters Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest the Tuo River enters from Zhangqiu, passes Mount Hu and the Luo marsh, becomes the Qinghe Channel to the northeast, and joins the waters of Changshan.

sentences.zh: 東南：孝婦河，即瀧水，自長山錯入。

translations.literal: To the southeast: the Xiaofu River, that is, the Long River, enters in a winding course from Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast the Xiaofu River—that is, the Long River—enters in a winding course from Changshan.

sentences.zh: 左合白條溝、沙河，逕伏生墓，屈東北，仍入之。

translations.literal: On the left it joins the Baitiao Channel and Sha River, passes the tomb of Fu Sheng, bends northeast, and again enters it.
translations.idiomatic: On the left it receives the Baitiao Channel and the Sha River, passes the tomb of Fu Sheng, bends northeast, and re-enters Changshan.

translations.literal: Its old course passed the old Liangzou city.
translations.idiomatic: Its former course passed the old site of Liangzou.

translations.literal: There is Sunjia Town.
translations.idiomatic: It had Sunjia Town.

translations.literal: Zichuan: simple.
translations.idiomatic: Zichuan County: rated lightly administered.

translations.literal: Two hundred twenty li east and slightly south of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay two hundred twenty li east and slightly south of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the southeast: Mount Yuan, from which the Zi River rises.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast stood Mount Yuan, where the Zi River has its source.

sentences.zh: 南有豬龍河，俗呼孝婦，即瀧水，自博山入，逕城西南，右合般水，又北逕浮山。

translations.literal: To the south is the Zhulong River, popularly called Xiaofu—that is, the Long River—which enters from Boshan, passes southwest of the city, joins the Pan River on the right, and again north passes Mount Fu.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lay the Zhulong River, commonly called the Xiaofu—that is, the Long River—which enters from Boshan, runs southwest of the city, receives the Pan River on the right, and then flows north past Mount Fu.

sentences.zh: 獺水河出黌山，逕昌國故城，會浸泗河自左注之，乃古德會水。

translations.literal: The Tashui River rises at Mount Huang, passes the old Changguo city, meets the Jinsi River entering from the left, and is the ancient Dehui River.
translations.idiomatic: The Tashui River rises at Mount Huang, passes the old site of Changguo, and receives the Jinsi River from the left—this was the ancient Dehui River.

translations.literal: On the left it receives the Mengshui mouth and enters Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: On the left it receives the Mengshui and flows into Changshan.

translations.literal: Railway.
translations.idiomatic: A railway passed through.

translations.literal: Changshan: simple.
translations.idiomatic: Changshan County: rated lightly administered.

translations.literal: One hundred ninety li east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred ninety li east of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the southwest: Mount Changbai.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest stood Mount Changbai.

translations.literal: To the south: Mount Feng.
translations.idiomatic: To the south stood Mount Feng.

translations.literal: To the northwest: Mount Xin.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest stood Mount Xin.

sentences.zh: 清河自鄒平入，折北入高苑。

translations.literal: The Qinghe River enters from Zouping, turns north, and enters Gaoyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The Qinghe River enters from Zouping, turns north, and flows into Gaoyuan.

translations.literal: The Qinghe Channel east enters Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Qinghe Channel flows east into Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 東南：孝婦河自淄川入，左得魚子溝，錯鄒平仍入。

translations.literal: To the southeast: the Xiaofu River enters from Zichuan, receives Yuzigou on the left, winds through Zouping, and again enters.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast the Xiaofu River enters from Zichuan, receives Yuzigou on the left, winds through Zouping, and re-enters the county.

translations.literal: There is Zhoucun Town.
translations.idiomatic: It had Zhoucun Town.

translations.literal: Xincheng: simple.
translations.idiomatic: Xincheng County: rated lightly administered.

translations.literal: Two hundred sixteen li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay two hundred sixteen li northeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the southeast: Mount Shang.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast stood Mount Shang.

sentences.zh: 西北：清河溝自長山入，右迤為青沙泊，淤。

translations.literal: To the northwest: the Qinghe Channel enters from Changshan, bends right into Qingsha Marsh, which is silted up.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest the Qinghe Channel enters from Changshan and spreads right into Qingsha Marsh, which has silted up.

sentences.zh: 東有烏河，即時水，逕西安故城，左納澇淄河，折北，逕會城湖入博興，西通麻大湖。

translations.literal: To the east is the Wu River, that is, the Shi River, which passes the old Xi'an city, receives the Laozi River on the left, turns north, passes Huicheng Lake and enters Boxing, and west connects with Mada Lake.
translations.idiomatic: To the east lay the Wu River—that is, the Shi River—which passes the old site of Xi'an, receives the Laozi River on the left, turns north past Huicheng Lake into Boxing, and westward connects with Mada Lake.

sentences.zh: 西北：孝婦河自長山入，右會鄭黃溝及系水，時枝津匯焉。

translations.literal: To the northwest: the Xiaofu River enters from Changshan, joins the Zhenghuang Channel and Xi River on the right, and branch channels of the Shi River gather here.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest the Xiaofu River enters from Changshan and on the right joins the Zhenghuang Channel and the Xi River, where distributaries of the Shi River converge.

translations.literal: Qihe: strategic, busy, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Qihe County: rated strategic, commercially busy, and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: Fifty li west of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay fifty li west of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西南：黃河左瀆自長清入，逕城南，又東入歷城。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the left branch of the Yellow River enters from Changqing, passes south of the city wall, and again east enters Licheng.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the left branch of the Yellow River enters from Changqing, runs south of the city wall, and then flows east into Licheng.

translations.literal: To the north: the Tuhai River enters from Yucheng.
translations.idiomatic: To the north the Tuhai River enters from Yucheng.

sentences.zh: 西南趙牛河自長清入，歧為岔河，併入禹城，而經流復入，合倪倫河自右注之，又東逕梁家莊入臨邑。

translations.literal: The Zhaoniu River southwest enters from Changqing, divides into the Cha River and together enters Yucheng, while the main stream again enters, joins the Nilun River entering from the right, and again east passes Liangjiazhuang and enters Lingyi.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhaoniu River enters from Changqing to the southwest, splits into the Cha River and flows together into Yucheng; the main channel then re-enters the county, receives the Nilun River from the right, and flows east past Liangjiazhuang into Lingyi.

translations.literal: Liuhong Town.
translations.idiomatic: It had Liuhong Town.

translations.literal: There is a post station called Yancheng.
translations.idiomatic: It had a courier station at Yancheng.

translations.literal: Qidong: worn and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Qidong County: rated fiscally strained and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: One hundred fifty li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred fifty li northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西北：黃河右瀆自濟陽入，逕延安鎮，又東緣惠民界入青城。

translations.literal: To the northwest: the right branch of the Yellow River enters from Jiyang, passes Yan'an Town, and again east along the Huimin border enters Qingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest the right branch of the Yellow River entered from Jiyang, passed Yan'an Town, and then ran east along the Huimin border into Qingcheng.

sentences.zh: 南：新小清，自章丘入，逕臨濟故城，又東入鄒平。

translations.literal: To the south: the New Xiaoqing River enters from Zhangqiu, passes the old Linji city, and again east enters Zouping.
translations.idiomatic: To the south the New Xiaoqing River entered from Zhangqiu, passed the old site of Linji, and flowed east into Zouping.

translations.literal: The Jianshui River and the Ba River are blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The Jianshui River and the Ba River were filled in.

translations.literal: Linhe Town.
translations.idiomatic: It had Linhe Town.

translations.literal: Jiyang: worn and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Jiyang County: rated fiscally strained and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: Seventy li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay seventy li northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 黃河左瀆自禹城入，逕城南，又東北緣齊東界入之。

translations.literal: The left branch of the Yellow River enters from Yucheng, passes south of the city wall, and again northeast along the Qidong border enters it.
translations.idiomatic: The left branch of the Yellow River entered from Yucheng, ran south of the city wall, and then flowed northeast along the Qidong border into the county.

sentences.zh: 西北：徒駭及商河，並自臨邑入，屈北入商河鎮。

translations.literal: To the northwest: the Tuhai and Shanghe rivers both enter from Lingyi, bend north, and enter Shanghe Town.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest the Tuhai and Shanghe rivers both entered from Lingyi, turned north, and flowed into Shanghe Town.

translations.literal: Two towns: Huihe and Xinshi.
translations.idiomatic: It had two towns: Huihe and Xinshi.

translations.literal: Yucheng: strategic.
translations.idiomatic: Yucheng County: rated strategic.

translations.literal: One hundred ten li northwest of the prefectural seat.

translations.idiomatic: It lay sixty li southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 雍正十二年自濟南來隸。

translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 12 (1735) it was transferred from Jinan to this prefecture.

sentences.zh: 黃河右瀆自齊東入，逕董溝東入濱。

translations.literal: The right branch of the Yellow River enters from Qidong, passes east of Donggou, and east enters Bin.

translations.literal: There is Tianzhen.

translations.idiomatic: It lay forty li northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西南：鉤盤自惠民入，逕紅廟庄，一曰信河，縣氏焉，東北入霑化，涸。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Goupan enters from Huimin, passes Hongmiaozhuang—also called Xin River, which gives the county its name—and northeast enters Zhanhua and dries up.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Goupan River entered from Huimin, passed Hongmiaozhuang—also called Xin River, from which the county took its name—and flowed northeast into Zhanhua, where it dried up.

translations.literal: The Sha River wrongly enters and still enters it.
translations.idiomatic: The Sha River entered in a winding course and rejoined it.

translations.literal: There is Qinfeng Town.
translations.idiomatic: It had Qinfeng Town.

translations.literal: Haifeng: lightly administered.
translations.idiomatic: Haifeng County: rated lightly administered.

translations.literal: Sixty li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay sixty li northeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the northwest: Liushan.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest stood Liushan.

sentences.zh: 海，東北百五十里，為大沽河口，與直隸鹽山接。

translations.literal: The sea: one hundred fifty li northeast, forming the Dagukou estuary, bordering on Yanshan in Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: The sea lay one hundred fifty li to the northeast at the Dagukou estuary, adjoining Yanshan in Zhili.

translations.literal: There is an inspection post.
translations.idiomatic: An inspection post was stationed there.

sentences.zh: 鬲津河逕馬谷山入，又東南，月河口。

translations.literal: The Gejin River passes Mount Magu and enters; again southeast, Yuehekou.
translations.idiomatic: The Gejin River passed Mount Magu and entered; farther southeast lay Yuehekou.

sentences.zh: 馬頰河自慶雲逕街東鎮入。

translations.idiomatic: The Majia River entered from Qingyun through Jiedong Town.

translations.literal: Its former course is silted up.
translations.idiomatic: Its former course was silted up.

translations.idiomatic: The present Majia River was opened in the Tang.

translations.literal: Again southeast, Shiqiaokou.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast was Shiqiaokou.

sentences.zh: 至霑化，鉤盤錯入仍入之。

translations.literal: Reaching Zhanhua, the Goupan wrongly enters and still enters it.
translations.idiomatic: At Zhanhua the Goupan River entered in a winding course and rejoined it.

translations.literal: There is Fenshui Town.
translations.idiomatic: It had Fenshui Town.

translations.literal: Leling: worn and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Leling County: rated fiscally strained and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: Ninety li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay ninety li northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西北：鬲津河，自直隸寧津入，錯南皮復入，入鹽山。

translations.literal: To the northwest: the Gejin River enters from Ningjin in Zhili, mistakenly enters Nanpi and again enters, and enters Yanshan.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest the Gejin River entered from Ningjin in Zhili, passed through Nanpi in a winding course, and flowed into Yanshan.

sentences.zh: 西南：馬頰，自德平入，東北逕興隆鎮入慶雲。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Majia from Deoping enters, northeast passes Xinglong Town and enters Qingyun.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Majia River entered from Deoping, passed northeast through Xinglong Town, and flowed into Qingyun.

sentences.zh: 古鉤盤，水經注屯氏別河，逕樂陵故城北，北瀆逕重合定縣故城南，並堙。

translations.idiomatic: The ancient Goupan—the Water Classic Commentary's Tunshi distributary—passed north of the Leling old city, and its northern distributary passed south of the Chonghe Ding county old city; both were silted up.

translations.literal: Jiuxian Town; the Ming established an inspection post, abolished.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiuxian Town the Ming had established an inspection post, later abolished.

translations.literal: Shanghe: busy, worn, and difficult.

translations.literal: Ninety li southwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay ninety li southwest of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: The ancient Shang River lies fifteen li to the north.
translations.idiomatic: The ancient Shang River lay fifteen li to the north.

sentences.zh: 水經注「逕朸縣故城南」，實沙河，今圖誤。

translations.literal: Water Classic Commentary: "passes south of the Lai county old city"; in fact it is the Sha River—the present map is mistaken.
translations.idiomatic: The Water Classic Commentary reads "passes south of the Lai county old city," but the channel is actually the Sha River—the present map is in error.

sentences.zh: 鉤盤自德平入，涸，而沙南徙，西首臨邑界，逕城南。

translations.literal: The Goupan enters from Deoping and dries up; the Sha shifts south, west beginning at the Lingyi border, passes south of the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: The Goupan River entered from Deoping and dried up; the Sha shifted southward, beginning in the west at the Lingyi border and passing south of the city wall.

sentences.zh: 南有徒駭，即古黃河，及其支津商河，自濟陽入，並東入惠民，而商與沙合。

translations.literal: To the south is the Tuo River—that is, the ancient Yellow River—and its branch channel the Shang River, both entering from Jiyang, together east entering Huimin, and the Shang and Sha join.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lay the Tuo River—the ancient Yellow River—and its branch channel the Shang River, which entered from Jiyang and flowed east together into Huimin, where the Shang and Sha united.

translations.literal: Kuanhe Town.
translations.idiomatic: It had Kuanhe Town.

translations.idiomatic: Binzhou: rated commercially busy and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: Ninety li east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay ninety li east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 十二年復將所領蒲臺、利津、霑化削。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year it again had its subordinate Putai, Lijin, and Zhanhua stripped away.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 12 (1735) its subordinate counties Putai, Lijin, and Zhanhua were again stripped away.

sentences.zh: 西南：黃河，自惠民、青城入，屈東北，錯蒲臺，復緣界故道左出，與合右瀆仍入之。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Yellow River enters from Huimin and Qingcheng, bends northeast, mistakenly enters Putai, again follows the border along the former channel and exits left, joins with and the right branch still enters it.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Yellow River entered from Huimin and Qingcheng, bent northeast, crossed into Putai in a winding course, then followed the border along the former left channel and, reuniting with the right branch, reentered the county.

sentences.zh: 徒駭自惠民入，左合沙河，涸。

translations.literal: The Tuo River enters from Huimin, joins the Sha River on the left, and dries up.
translations.idiomatic: The Tuo River entered from Huimin, received the Sha River on the left, and dried up.

translations.literal: Winding northeast, it enters Zhanhua.
translations.idiomatic: It wound northeast into Zhanhua.

translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred fifty li east of the prefectural seat.

translations.idiomatic: The sea lay one hundred sixty li to the northeast.

translations.literal: To the west it borders Zhanhua.
translations.idiomatic: On the west it bordered Zhanhua.

sentences.zh: 西南：黃河，自濱、蒲臺入，側城東北，入為牡蠣嘴。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Yellow River enters from Bin and Putai, passes northeast of the city wall, and where it enters is called Oyster Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Yellow River entered from Bin and Putai, ran along the northeast side of the seat, and entered at Oyster Mouth.

translations.literal: Fengguo Town has an inspection post.
translations.idiomatic: At Fengguo Town an inspection post was stationed.

translations.literal: Zhanhua: difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Zhanhua County: rated difficult to govern.

translations.literal: Seventy li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay seventy li northeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: The sea: one hundred li north and slightly east.
translations.idiomatic: The sea lay one hundred li north and slightly east.

translations.literal: To the west it borders Haifeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the west it bordered Haifeng.

sentences.zh: 西有鉤盤河自陽信入，錯海豐復入，又東南大洋口。

translations.literal: To the west is the Goupan River, which enters from Yangxin, mistakenly enters Haifeng and reenters, and again southeast to Dayangkou.
translations.idiomatic: To the west the Goupan River entered from Yangxin, crossed into Haifeng in a winding course and reentered, then ran southeast to Dayangkou.

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Tuo River enters from Bin.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Tuo River entered from Bin.

translations.literal: Towns: Yongfeng; at Jiushan there is a disused inspection post.
translations.idiomatic: Towns: Yongfeng; at Jiushan there was a disused inspection post.

translations.idiomatic: Putai County: rated fiscally strained and difficult to govern.

translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred twenty li east and slightly south of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yongzheng it came from Bin to be subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 12 (1735) it was transferred from Bin to be subordinate here.

sentences.zh: 西有黃河自濱入，逕城南，又東北，左瀆仍緣濱合故道入利津。

translations.literal: To the west is the Yellow River, which enters from Bin, passes straight south of the city wall, again northeast; the left branch still follows Bin along the former channel and enters Lijin.
translations.idiomatic: To the west the Yellow River entered from Bin, ran past the south side of the seat, then turned northeast; the left branch still followed Bin along the former channel and entered Lijin.

translations.literal: Dragon Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Dragon Lake.

translations.literal: Town: Longhun.
translations.idiomatic: Town: Longhun.

translations.literal: Linqing Directly Administered Department: strategic, busy, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Linqing Directly Administered Department: rated strategic, commercially busy, and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: Subordinate to the Jidong Taiwu Lin Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: It was subordinate to the Jidong Taiwu Lin circuit.

sentences.zh: 初沿明制，為東昌屬州，領縣二。

translations.literal: At first, following the Ming system, it was a department subordinate to Dongchang governing two counties.
translations.idiomatic: At first, following the Ming system, it was a department subordinate to Dongchang and governed two counties.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年直隸，割武城、夏津、丘還隸，而館陶還東昌。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Qianlong it became directly administered; Wucheng, Xiajin, and Qiu were detached and returned to its jurisdiction, while Guantao returned to Dongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 41 (1776) it was made directly administered; Wucheng, Xiajin, and Qiu were detached and placed under it, while Guantao returned to Dongchang.

translations.literal: One hundred ten li southeast of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred ten li southeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 廣百五十二里，袤百三十里。

translations.literal: Its width was one hundred fifty-two li and its length one hundred thirty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured one hundred fifty-two li across and one hundred thirty li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高三十六度五十七分。

translations.literal: North polar altitude was thirty-six degrees fifty-seven minutes.
translations.idiomatic: Its north polar altitude was thirty-six degrees fifty-seven minutes.

translations.literal: It lay thirty-six minutes west of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: It lay thirty-six minutes west of the capital.

translations.literal: It governed three counties.
translations.idiomatic: It governed three counties.

sentences.zh: 東有運河自清平入，逕城南，西南衛河自館陶來會，是為南運河，亦通曰衛河，貫城而北，擅屯氏故瀆，入直隸清河。

translations.idiomatic: To the east the Grand Canal entered from Qingping and ran past the south side of the seat; from the southwest the Wei River from Guantao joined it—the Southern Grand Canal, also commonly called the Wei River—which pierced the city and ran north along the Tun clan's former channel into Qinghe in Zhili.

sentences.zh: 古黃河，東北自館陶入，歧為沙河，併入夏津。

translations.idiomatic: The old Yellow River entered northeast from Guantao, branched into the Sha River, and merged into Xiajin.

translations.idiomatic: Wucheng County: rated strategic and commercially busy.

translations.literal: One hundred li north and slightly east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred li north and slightly east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 南有衛河自夏津入，逕城西，折東北，復會沙河，錯恩復入，入直隸故城。

translations.idiomatic: To the south the Wei River entered from Xiajin, ran past the west side of the seat, turned northeast, rejoined the Sha River, crossed into En in a winding course and reentered, and flowed into Gucheng in Zhili.

translations.literal: Formerly there were the Yizi, Huanglu, and Wugou waters.
translations.idiomatic: Former waterways included the Yizi, Huanglu, and Wugou streams.

sentences.zh: 縣卑淖，金末艾家凹水濼，廣數十里，深一丈。

translations.idiomatic: The county lay low and marshy; late in the Jin at Aijia'ao lay a water marsh several tens of li across and one zhang deep.

translations.idiomatic: The Han Fuyang old city site is now Raoyang Town.

translations.literal: Jiamaying Inspection Post; also a courier station.
translations.idiomatic: At Jiamaying an inspection post and a courier station were stationed.

translations.literal: Forty li east and slightly north of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay forty li east and slightly north of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the north: Sunsheng Town.
translations.idiomatic: To the north: Sunsheng Town.

sentences.zh: 西有衛河自州入，再錯直隸清河入，入武城。

translations.idiomatic: To the west the Wei River entered from the department, crossed again into Qinghe in Zhili in a winding course, and flowed into Wucheng.

sentences.zh: 舊有沙河自州入，東有古黃河、馬頰，並自清平入，入恩。

translations.literal: Formerly the Sha River entered from the department; to the east were the old Yellow River and Majia, both entering from Qingping and entering En.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Sha River entered from the department; to the east the old Yellow River and Majia both entered from Qingping and flowed into En.

translations.literal: Qiu: lightly administered.
translations.idiomatic: Qiu County: rated lightly administered.

translations.literal: Eighty li southwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay eighty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

translations.idiomatic: The Zhang River—this was the channel cut straight from Pinggudian in Guangping in Shunzhi 9 (1652), not the old Zhang course.

sentences.zh: 二並自直隸曲周入，一逕城西，至宋八甿仍入之，一逕城東，至柳甿入清河。

translations.literal: Two together enter from Quzhou in Zhili; one passes straight west of the city wall to Songbabeng and still enters it, one passes straight east of the city wall to Liubeng and enters Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: Two branches entered together from Quzhou in Zhili: one ran past the west side of the seat to Songbabeng and reentered it; the other ran past the east side to Liubeng and entered Qinghe.

translations.literal: Yanzhou Prefecture: strategic, busy, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Yanzhou Prefecture: rated strategic, commercially busy, and difficult to govern.

translations.idiomatic: A regional commander was stationed there; it was the seat of the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit.

sentences.zh: 初沿明制，領州四，縣二十三。

translations.idiomatic: At first, following the Ming system, it governed four departments and twenty-three counties.

translations.idiomatic: During the Yongzheng period Yi, Cao, Jining, and Dongping were reorganized, and Jining was made directly administered.

translations.idiomatic: Thirteen counties were successively detached to other jurisdictions, while Dongping was reduced and Tai'an was cut away.

sentences.zh: 東北距省治三百二十里。

translations.literal: Three hundred twenty li northeast of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay three hundred twenty li northeast of the provincial seat.

sentences.zh: 廣五百十里，袤二百六十里。

translations.idiomatic: It measured five hundred ten li across and two hundred sixty li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 北極高三十五度四十二分。

translations.idiomatic: Mount Zi lay thirty li to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 西北：漕河，自寧陽入，左合漢馬，右洸河，亦南入濟寧，涸。

translations.idiomatic: To the northwest the transport river entered from Ningyang, joined Hanma on the left and the Guang River on the right, also ran south into Jining, and dried up.

translations.literal: Old-city courier stations two: Changping and Xinjia.
translations.idiomatic: Two old-city courier stations: Changping and Xinjia.

translations.literal: Qufu: lightly administered.

translations.idiomatic: The Wen again followed the border, passed Han Wenyang to the Gang old city; the Guang River rose there—what is called 'the Wen forms the barrier'—and together with the transport river and Han Baima flowed south into Ziyang.

sentences.zh: 正渠復逕春城口入東平。

translations.idiomatic: The main channel again passed Chunchengkou and entered Dongping.

translations.idiomatic: The railway passed through.

sentences.zh: 南：昌平，而岱脈南馳寧陽、曲阜。

sentences.zh: 入東北六里，曰尼山，其西南昌平有鄉，孔子生焉，故屬曲阜。

translations.idiomatic: Six li to the northeast lay Mount Ni; southwest of it Changping had a township where Confucius was born, hence it belonged to Qufu.

sentences.zh: 今山南長莎村相近四基西麓，孟子墓在焉。

translations.literal: Today south of the mountain near Changsha Village and the western foothills of the Four Foundations lies Mencius's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: Today south of the mountain, near Changsha Village and the western foothills of the Four Foundations, lay Mencius's tomb.

sentences.zh: 沂水導源尼山，西與蓼水併入曲阜，注泗。

translations.literal: The Yi River takes its source at Mount Ni, west joins Liao water and together enters Qufu, and joins the Si.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi River took its source at Mount Ni, joined the Liao westward and together entered Qufu, and joined the Si.

sentences.zh: 泗復自滋陽入，西北錯濟寧復入，入魚臺。

translations.idiomatic: The Si again entered from Ziyang, crossed northwest into Jining in a winding course and reentered, and flowed into Yutai.

translations.idiomatic: The Liao River also reentered, met Xihu Lake water to form the Baima River, and joined the Great Sha and Honggou rivers, following them.

translations.literal: To the northeast: Mount Li, Mount Gui, and Mount Peiwei.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast: Mount Li, Mount Gui, and Mount Peiwei.

translations.idiomatic: At Taoxu the Si River rose; north of it Mount Guan rose, from which the Zhu River issued; it passed the Bian old city and joined.

translations.literal: To the south: Gugu city.
translations.idiomatic: To the south lay Gugu city.

sentences.zh: 又西，左合黃淵、右金線諸河，入曲阜。

translations.literal: Again west, on the left joined the Huangyuan and on the right the Golden Thread and other rivers, entering Qufu.
translations.idiomatic: Westward again it joined the Huangyuan on the left and the Golden Thread and other rivers on the right, and entered Qufu.

translations.idiomatic: It had eighty-seven springs supplying the canal transport system.

translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred forty li southeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the southeast: Peach Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast: Peach Mountain.

sentences.zh: 狐駘自嶧入，逕微山湖，右有許由泉，自嶧入，為南明河。

translations.literal: The Hulu enters from Yi, passes Weishan Lake, and on the right is Xuyou Spring, which enters from Yi and becomes the Nanming River.
translations.idiomatic: The Hulu entered from Yi, passed Weishan Lake, and on the right Xuyou Spring entered from Yi to form the Nanming River.

sentences.zh: 薛河逕昌慮南，石橋泉逕薛城注之，再錯出江蘇沛縣。

translations.literal: The Xue River passes south of Changlu, the Shiqiao Spring passes Xue city and pours into it, and again mistakenly exits in Pei County, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: The Xue River ran south of Changlu; the Shiqiao Spring passed Xue city and poured into it; the course again crossed out into Pei County in Jiangsu in a winding path.

sentences.zh: 漷水出東北述山，逕藍陵、祝其、合鄉故城，合南梁水、趵突入沛注之，復入，右合三里河，北沙河自鄒入，夾休城，其白馬河入合界河為郁郎淵注之，又西北入魚臺。

translations.literal: The Huo River rises from Shushan in the northeast, passes Lanling, Zhuqi, and Hexiang old cities, joins the Nanliang River and the Baotu Spring and enters Pei to pour in, reenters, on the right joins the Sanli River, the North Sha River enters from Zou, flanks Xiucheng, its Baima River enters and joins the Jie River to form the Yulang Deep and pour in, and again northwest enters Yutai.
translations.idiomatic: The Huo River rose from Shushan in the northeast, passed the old cities of Lanling, Zhuqi, and Hexiang, joined the Nanliang River and Baotu Spring and entered Pei to pour in, reentered, joined the Sanli River on the right, the North Sha River entered from Zou and flanked Xiucheng, its Baima River entered and joined the Jie River to form the Yulang Deep and pour in, and again flowed northwest into Yutai.

sentences.zh: 東北：小沂水，入費，而昭陽湖堙。

translations.literal: To the northeast: the Lesser Yi River enters Fei, and Zhaoyang Lake is silted up.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast the Lesser Yi River entered Fei, and Zhaoyang Lake was silted up.

sentences.zh: 相近車梢峪，水出焉，曰滄浪淵，會許池泉，逕葛嶧山，合金注河，其南茅茨、仙人河。

translations.literal: Nearby Chesao Valley, water rises there called Canglang Deep, meets Xuchi Spring, passes Mount Geyi, joins the Jinzhu River, and to its south Maoci and the Immortal River.
translations.idiomatic: Nearby Chesao Valley, where water rose in the Canglang Deep, met Xuchi Spring, passed Mount Geyi, joined the Jinzhu River, and to the south lay Maoci and the Immortal River.

sentences.zh: 東南，運河自江蘇邳州入合之，又北逕微山湖、南陽湖入滕。

translations.idiomatic: To the southeast the Grand Canal entered from Pizhou in Jiangsu and joined it; it then ran north through Weishan Lake and Nanyang Lake into Teng.

translations.idiomatic: To the northeast: Mount Taibai and Mount Tan.

sentences.zh: 西南：趙王河，自鄆城入，入嘉祥。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Zhao King River enters from Yuncheng and enters Jiaxiang.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Zhao King River entered from Yuncheng and flowed into Jiaxiang.

sentences.zh: 北有汶水，自東平入，受濼澢諸泉、蒲灣泊水，曰魯溝，西南擅鵝河故瀆，注南旺湖，濟運運河，遂東南入嘉祥達濟寧，西北入東平達臨清。

translations.literal: To the north is the Wen River, which enters from Dongping, receives the Luohao springs, Pawan Marsh water, called Lu Gully, southwest the Shan's Goose River old course, pours into Nanwang Lake, supplies the canal transport Grand Canal, then southeast enters Jiaxiang reaching Jining, northwest enters Dongping reaching Linqing.
translations.idiomatic: To the north the Wen River entered from Dongping, received the Luohao springs and Pawan Marsh water to form the Lu Gully, and its southwest branch along the Shan's Goose River old course poured into Nanwang Lake and fed the canal transport Grand Canal; it then ran southeast into Jiaxiang to reach Jining and northwest into Dongping to reach Linqing.

translations.idiomatic: Chaicheng Town.

translations.idiomatic: It lay three hundred li northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 南有黃河，自范入，錯壽張入。

translations.idiomatic: To the south the Yellow River entered from Fan and crossed in a winding course into Shouzhang.

sentences.zh: 運河入，逕東阿故城，有阿澤，又北入聊城。

translations.idiomatic: The Grand Canal entered, passed the Dong'a old city where A Marsh lay, and again ran north into Liaocheng.

sentences.zh: 西：徒駭河故道，自范入，錯朝城，莘，再入，入聊城。

translations.idiomatic: To its south Shawan and the Ju River together merged into Yuncheng.

translations.literal: There is Zhukou Town.
translations.idiomatic: It had Zhukou Town.

translations.idiomatic: Yizhou Prefecture: rated strategic, commercially busy, and difficult to govern.

translations.idiomatic: It was subordinate to the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji circuit.

sentences.zh: 初沿明制，為兗州屬州，領縣二。

sentences.zh: 沂水又南逕龍塘口，右歧為武河，其東白馬河。

translations.literal: The Yi River again south passes Longtangkou, on the right branches into the Wu River, and to its east the Baima River.
translations.idiomatic: The Yi River again ran south past Longtangkou, branched on the right into the Wu River, and to its east lay the Baima River.

sentences.zh: 東北：沭水，自莒入，右合溫泉水，右武陽溝，再入郯城，而武河、蘆塘河錯郯城復入而合。

translations.idiomatic: To the northeast the Shu River entered from Ju, joined Wenquan water on the right and Wuyang Ditch on the right, reentered Tancheng, while the Wu River and Lutang River crossed Tancheng in a winding course, reentered, and joined.

translations.idiomatic: The Shu River reentered from Lanshan, passed northeast of the city, received the Mo River old course on the right, circled south of the city, and entered Suqian.

translations.literal: Again south, passes Mount Maling, west to Honghuabu, again west, the Baima River enters and passes west of the city, together enters Suqian, Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south it passed Mount Maling west to Honghuabu; farther west the Baima River entered, passed west of the city, and together flowed into Suqian in Jiangsu.

translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred ten li southeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: Anling and Panshi towns.
translations.idiomatic: Towns: Anling and Panshi.

translations.idiomatic: An assistant magistrate was posted at Liujiakou.

translations.idiomatic: Dingtao County: rated lightly administered.

South of the South Canal the Liu River and Sha River both entered from Cao and flowed into Chengwu, but all have dried up.

translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred twenty li north of the prefectural seat.

translations.idiomatic: Linzi County: rated lightly administered.

translations.literal: Fifty-five li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay fifty-five li northwest of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the southwest: Yanzhong Valley.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest: Yanzhong Valley.

translations.literal: To the west: Kuiqiu.
translations.idiomatic: To the west: Kuiqiu.

sentences.zh: 南有淄水自益都入，水經注，逕牛山西，其北營丘，東得天齊水口，又北逕管仲墓，至城東，逕雪宮西高敬仲墓東入樂安。

translations.literal: To the south the Zi River enters from Yidu; the Shui Jing Zhu: it passes west of Mount Niu, to its north Yingqiu, east receives the Tianqi River mouth, farther north passes Guan Zhong's tomb, reaches east of the city, passes west of Xue Palace and east of Gao Jingzhong's tomb and enters Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: To the south the Zi River entered from Yidu; per the Shui Jing Zhu it passed west of Mount Niu, with Yingqiu to its north, received the Tianqi River mouth on the east, passed farther north by Guan Zhong's tomb, reached east of the city, passed west of Xue Palace and east of Gao Jingzhong's tomb, and entered Le'an.

sentences.zh: 西南：時水自益都分入而合，北逕杜山，右合澅水及系水、京水，又北折西，一曰烏河，即乾時，入新城。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Shi River branches from Yidu and rejoins, north passes Mount Du, on the right joining the Hu, Xi, and Jing rivers; farther north bends west—also called the Wu River, which is Qianshi—and enters Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Shi River branched from Yidu and rejoined, passed north along Mount Du, joined the Hu, Xi, and Jing rivers on the right, then bent northwest—also called the Wu River, that is Qianshi—and entered Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 西北：澠水，亦漢溱，分入樂安、博興。

translations.literal: To the northwest: the Mian River, also the Han-era Qin, branches into Le'an and Boxing.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest: the Mian River, also the Han-era Qin, branched into Le'an and Boxing.

translations.literal: Zhou Li: "Its inundation is Zishi."
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou Li states, "Its inundation is Zishi."

sentences.zh: 東南：鼎足山，地理志「菟頭，女水出」，北逕故酅亭，伏，至漢東安平故城復出。

translations.literal: To the southeast: Mount Dingzu; the Geography Monograph's "Mount Tutou, the Nü River rises," north passes the old Yi post, goes underground, and re-emerges at the Han-era old city of Dong'anping.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast: Mount Dingzu; the Geography Monograph's "Mount Tutou, the Nü River rises"—it passed north by the old Yi post, went underground, and re-emerged at the Han-era old city of Dong'anping.

translations.literal: Boxing: simple.
translations.idiomatic: Boxing County: rated lightly administered.

translations.literal: One hundred ten li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred ten li northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 西南：小清河、支脈溝自高苑入，並淤。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Xiaoqing River and Zhimai Ditch enter from Gaoyuan, both silted up.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Xiaoqing River and Zhimai Ditch entered from Gaoyuan, both silted up.

sentences.zh: 今自馬踏湖納新城澇淄水，左得小清故道，故亦曰小清河。

translations.literal: Today from Mata Lake it receives the Xincheng Lao-Zi River; on the left it gains the old course of the Xiaoqing, so it is also called the Xiaoqing River.
translations.idiomatic: Today it receives the Xincheng Lao-Zi River from Mata Lake; on the left it takes the old course of the Xiaoqing, and is therefore also called the Xiaoqing River.

sentences.zh: 又東為會城泊，水經注「平州坑右納漢溱」，即澠水，出為預備河，併入樂安。

translations.literal: Farther east is Huicheng Marsh; the Shui Jing Zhu's "Pingzhou Pit on the right receives the Han Qin"—that is the Mian River—issues as the Yubei River and merges into Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east lies Huicheng Marsh; the Shui Jing Zhu's "Pingzhou Pit on the right receives the Han Qin"—the Mian River—issued as the Yubei River and merged into Le'an.

translations.literal: The Yecheng River is blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The Yecheng River was blocked.

translations.literal: There is Chunhua Town.
translations.idiomatic: There is Chunhua Town.

translations.literal: Gaoyuan: simple.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoyuan County: rated lightly administered.

translations.literal: One hundred fifty li northwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred fifty li northwest of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 南有小清河，自新城入，至軍張閘，右得故道，左為支脈溝，俗岔河，東入博興。

translations.literal: To the south is the Xiaoqing River, entering from Xincheng to Junzhang Sluice; on the right it gains the old course, on the left is the Zhimai Ditch, popularly the Cha River, east entering Boxing.
translations.idiomatic: To the south the Xiaoqing River entered from Xincheng to Junzhang Sluice; on the right it took the old course, on the left the Zhimai Ditch—popularly the Cha River—entered east into Boxing.

translations.literal: Tian Town, where the Heng sub-prefecture was located.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Town, seat of the Heng sub-prefecture.

translations.literal: Le'an: strategic and busy.
translations.idiomatic: Le'an County: rated strategic and commercially busy.

translations.literal: Ninety li north slightly east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay ninety li north slightly east of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 海，東北百三十里，自利津迤東南為淄河口，有小清、支脈溝自博興入之。

translations.literal: The sea, one hundred thirty li northeast; from Lijin extending southeast to the Zihe Mouth, the Xiaoqing and Zhimai Ditch enter from Boxing.
translations.idiomatic: The sea lay one hundred thirty li northeast; from Lijin extending southeast to the Zihe Mouth the Xiaoqing and Zhimai Ditch entered from Boxing.

sentences.zh: 一故道至壽光界，今小清入。

translations.literal: One old course reaches the Shouguang border; today the Xiaoqing enters.
translations.idiomatic: One old course reached the Shouguang border; today the Xiaoqing enters.

sentences.zh: 西北其富民河亦入焉，右會淄水，緣其界，其女水入，分流折東併入之。

translations.literal: To the northwest its Fumin River also enters there; on the right joining the Zi River along its border, its Nü River enters, branches, bends east, and merges into it.
translations.idiomatic: To the northwest its Fumin River also entered there; on the right it joined the Zi River along its border, its Nü River entered, branched, bent east, and merged into it.

sentences.zh: 西南：澠水自臨淄錯入，亦仍入之。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Mian River from Linzi enters circuitously and also still enters it.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Mian River from Linzi entered circuitously and rejoined it.

translations.literal: Le'an and Gaojiagang towns.
translations.idiomatic: Le'an and Gaojiagang towns.

translations.literal: Tangtou Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Tangtou Stockade.

translations.literal: Shouguang: strategic, busy, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Shouguang County: rated strategic, commercially busy, and difficult to administer.

translations.literal: Sixty li northeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay sixty li northeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 海，東北百四十里，自樂安迤東南為淄河門。

translations.literal: The sea, one hundred forty li northeast; from Le'an extending southeast to the Zihe Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The sea lay one hundred forty li northeast; from Le'an extending southeast to the Zihe Gate.

sentences.zh: 西南，清水泊，古鉅定，有鹽城，匯益都躍龍、王欽、北陽河，臨淄女水、小清古瀆。

translations.literal: To the southwest, Qingshui Marsh, ancient Juding, has Yancheng; it collects Yidu's Yuelong, Wangqin, and Beiyang rivers, Linzi's Nü River, and the Xiaoqing ancient channel.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest lies Qingshui Marsh, ancient Juding, with Yancheng; it collected Yidu's Yuelong, Wangqin, and Beiyang rivers, Linzi's Nü River, and the Xiaoqing ancient channel.

sentences.zh: 又東南，洱河口水，南自益都入，逕劇故城，古紀國，又北逕黑家泊，又東南至濰。

translations.literal: Farther southeast, Erhe Mouth water; south from Yidu it enters, passes the old city of Ju, ancient Ji state, farther north passes Heijia Marsh, farther southeast to Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southeast at Erhe Mouth water from Yidu entered in the south, passed the old city of Ju of the ancient Ji state, passed north by Heijia Marsh, and continued southeast to Wei.

sentences.zh: 東南：堯河，亦自益都入，逕故樂城。

translations.literal: To the southeast: the Yao River, also enters from Yidu, passes the old city of Lecheng.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast the Yao River likewise entered from Yidu and passed the old city of Lecheng.

sentences.zh: 南丹河自昌樂入，逕斟灌國。

translations.literal: The Nandan River enters from Changle, passes the state of Zhenguan.
translations.idiomatic: The Nandan River entered from Changle and passed the old territory of Zhenguan.

translations.literal: Its Gui River enters, passes the old Leyue.
translations.idiomatic: Its Gui River entered and passed the old site of Leyue.

translations.literal: Guangling and Hou towns.
translations.idiomatic: Guangling and Hou towns.

translations.literal: Linqu: simple.
translations.idiomatic: Linqu County: rated lightly administered.

translations.literal: Forty-five li south slightly east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay forty-five li south slightly east of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: Mount Qu, two li east.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Qu lay two li to the east.

translations.literal: To the west: Mount Feng.
translations.idiomatic: To the west stood Mount Feng.

translations.literal: To the southeast: Great Bian.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast lay Great Bian.

translations.literal: To the southwest: Baqi, Mount Song, and Great Xian.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest stood Baqi, Mount Song, and Great Xian.

translations.literal: There is one pass, called Muling, with an inspection post.
translations.idiomatic: It had one pass, Muling, with an inspection post.

sentences.zh: 地理志，朱虛東泰山，今沂山，汶水出其東，東北左合英山水，入安丘。

translations.literal: Geographic Treatise: Zhuxu Eastern Mount Tai, now Mount Yi; the Wen River rises on its east, northeast on the left joins Yingshan River water, enters Anqiu.
translations.idiomatic: The Geography Monograph records that Zhuxu's Eastern Mount Tai is today's Mount Yi; the Wen River rose on its eastern flank, joined the Yingshan River on the northeast left, and entered Anqiu.

sentences.zh: 其北虛水、西丹水並從之。

translations.literal: Its Beixu River and West Dan River both follow it.
translations.idiomatic: Its Beixu River and West Dan River both joined it.

sentences.zh: 巨洋水出其西北，逕月明崖，右合龍門、南丹，左略逯、冶泉，逕城東，又北逕委粟山，左納石膏水，入益都。

translations.literal: The Juyang River rises from its northwest, passes Yueming Cliff, on the right joins Longmen and Nandan, on the left Luelu and Yequan, passes east of the city, again north passes Weisu Mountain, on the left receives Shigao River water, enters Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: The Juyang River rose in the northwest, passed Yueming Cliff, received Longmen and Nandan on the right and Luelu and Yequan on the left, ran east of the city, turned north past Mount Weisu, took in the Shigao River on the left, and entered Yidu.

sentences.zh: 其東康浪水、洗耳河、堯水從之。

translations.literal: To its east the Kanglang River, Xier River, and Yao River follow it.
translations.idiomatic: On its east the Kanglang River, Xier River, and Yao River joined it.

translations.literal: Anqiu: busy and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Anqiu County: rated commercially busy and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: One hundred sixty li southeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred sixty li southeast of the prefectural seat.

sentences.zh: 安丘山，西南十五里，即今牟山，所謂牟婁，古牟夷國。

translations.literal: Mount Anqiu, fifteen li southwest, which is today's Mount Mou, called Mou lou, ancient Mouyi state.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Anqiu lay fifteen li southwest—today's Mount Mou, known as Moulou, seat of the ancient Mouyi state.

translations.literal: Farther southwest: Mount Liu, Mount Yu, and Shuyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Farther southwest stood Mount Liu, Mount Yu, and Shuyuan.

translations.literal: To the northeast: Mount Dan.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast stood Mount Dan.

sentences.zh: 南有峿水，自莒入，左合淇河、雹泉河，東入諸城。

translations.literal: To the south is the Yu River, entering from Ju, on the left joining the Qi River and Baobai Spring River, east entering Zhucheng.
translations.idiomatic: To the south the Yu River entered from Ju, received the Qi River and Baobai Spring River on the left, and flowed east into Zhucheng.

sentences.zh: 東南：濰水，自諸城入，逕礪阜山，左合小峿水，側有蓋公山，又北緣昌邑界復入，逕岞山入濰。

translations.literal: To the southeast: the Wei River, entering from Zhucheng, passes Mount Lifu, on the left joins the Lesser Yu River, beside is Mount Gaigong, again north along the Changyi border re-enters, passes Mount Zuo and enters Wei.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast the Wei River entered from Zhucheng, passed Mount Lifu, received the Lesser Yu River on the left with Mount Gaigong beside it, ran north along the Changyi border and re-entered, passed Mount Zuo, and flowed into Wei.

sentences.zh: 汶水西自臨朐入，左合金山，右合牛沭山水，水經注「東北逕漢故郚城北、管寧冢東、孫嵩墓東、柴阜山西」，今右合靈水，又側城東北逕漢故淳于，從之。

translations.literal: The Wen River west from Linqu enters, on the left joins Jingshan, on the right joins the Niushu Mountain River water; Water Classic Commentary "northeast passes north of the Han old city of Yi, east of Guan Ning's tomb, east of Sun Song's tomb, west of Mount Chaifu"—today on the right joins the Ling River, again beside the city's northeast passes the Han old Chunyu, and follows it.
translations.idiomatic: The Wen River entered from Linqu in the west, received Jingshan on the left and the Niushu Mountain River on the right. The Water Classic Commentary reads that it "ran northeast past the north of the Han-era old city of Yi, east of Guan Ning's tomb and Sun Song's tomb, and west of Mount Chaifu"; today it received the Ling River on the right, ran beside the northeast of the city past the Han-era old site of Chunyu, and continued on.

translations.literal: Town: Lizhang.
translations.idiomatic: Town: Lizhang.

translations.literal: Jingzhi, where an assistant magistrate was stationed.
translations.idiomatic: At Jingzhi an assistant magistrate was posted.

translations.literal: Changle: strategic and busy.
translations.idiomatic: Changle County: rated strategic and commercially busy.

translations.literal: Seventy li east of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay seventy li east of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the east: Mount Hu.
translations.idiomatic: To the east stood Mount Hu.

translations.literal: To the south: Mount Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: To the south stood Mount Qiao.

sentences.zh: 東南：叢角，小汶河出，入安丘。

translations.literal: To the southeast: Congjiao; the Lesser Wen River rises and enters Anqiu.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast at Congjiao the Lesser Wen River rose and entered Anqiu.

sentences.zh: 塔山，水經注覆甑，溉水出。

translations.literal: Mount Ta; Water Classic Commentary Fuzhen; the Gai River rises.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Ta—the Water Classic Commentary's Fuzhen—from which the Gai River rose.

translations.literal: To its west, the Xiaoyi River.
translations.idiomatic: To its west lay the Xiaoyi River.

sentences.zh: 西南：擂鼓，白狼河出，東逕後魏故營陵。

translations.literal: To the southwest: Leigu; the Bailang River rises, east passes the Later Wei old Yingling.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest at Leigu the Bailang River rose and ran east past the Later Wei-era old site of Yingling.

translations.literal: To the southeast: Mount Fang; the Yu River rises.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast at Mount Fang the Yu River rose.

translations.literal: Merges into Wei.
translations.idiomatic: It merged into the Wei River.

sentences.zh: 其北麓，桂河出，其西麓，東丹水出，西丹水自朐來入會，逕北郝集，丹朱墓在焉。

translations.literal: On its northern foothill the Gui River rises; on its western foothill the East Dan River rises; the West Dan River from Qu comes to join the meeting, passes Beihaoji; Dan Zhu's tomb is there.
translations.idiomatic: On its northern foothills the Gui River rose and on its western foothills the East Dan River; the West Dan River came from Qu to join them, passed Beihaoji, where the tomb of Dan Zhu stood.

sentences.zh: 其西：堯水，自益都緣界，並北入壽光。

translations.literal: To its west: the Yao River, from Yidu along the border, both north enter Shouguang.
translations.idiomatic: To its west the Yao River ran from Yidu along the border and entered Shouguang together in the north.

translations.literal: Danhe Town.
translations.idiomatic: Danhe Town.

translations.literal: Railway.
translations.idiomatic: Railway.

translations.literal: Zhucheng: strategic, busy, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Zhucheng County: rated strategic, commercially busy, and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: Two hundred eighty li southeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay two hundred eighty li southeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the southeast: Mount Langya, Yunmu, and Fenghuo.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast stood Mount Langya, Yunmu, and Fenghuo.

translations.literal: To the south: Mount Huang.
translations.idiomatic: To the south stood Mount Huang.

translations.literal: To the southwest: Horse's Ear;
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest stood Horse's Ear;

sentences.zh: 九仙山，潮河出，會北源石河峪水，逕故梁鄉，入日照，達于海。

translations.literal: Mount Jiuxian; the Chao River rises, joins the north source Shiheyu River water, passes the old Liang township, enters Rizhao, reaches the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Jiuxian, where the Chao River rose, joined the northern source of the Shiheyu River, passed the old township of Liang, entered Rizhao, and reached the sea.

sentences.zh: 海又東為宋家河口，距城百二十里，黃山河入。

translations.literal: The sea farther east is Songjiahe Mouth, one hundred twenty li from the city; the Huanghe River enters.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east the coast formed Songjiahe Mouth, one hundred twenty li from the city, where the Yellow River entered.

sentences.zh: 又東，徐家港，紀里河納白馬河入。

translations.literal: Farther east, Xujiapu; the Jili River receives the Baima River and enters.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east lay Xujiapu, where the Jili River took in the Baima River.

sentences.zh: 又東，崔家溜口，東南橫河東源自膠入，會西源入。

translations.literal: Farther east, Cuijialiu Mouth; southeast the Heng River's east source from Jiao enters, joins the west source and enters.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east at Cuijialiu Mouth the Heng River's eastern source entered from Jiao and joined its western source.

translations.literal: Outside it, Muguan Island.
translations.idiomatic: Offshore lay Muguan Island.

translations.literal: Farther east, Duck Island.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east lay Duck Island.

translations.literal: Extending north, Zhitang Island.
translations.idiomatic: Running north was Zhitang Island.

translations.literal: Farther north, Longtan Mouth;
translations.idiomatic: Farther north lay Longtan Mouth;

translations.literal: Langya Terrace is there.
translations.idiomatic: where Langya Terrace stood.

translations.literal: To the Ju border, the Wei River enters.
translations.idiomatic: At the Ju border the Wei River entered.

sentences.zh: 西南：涓水，納白納河，自其右注之，左納西商溝河。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Juan River, receives the Bainai River, from its right pours in, on the left receives the Xishanggou River.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Juan River took in the Bainai River from the right and received the Xishanggou River on the left.

sentences.zh: 又東逕白玉山，右合扶淇水，至城北。

translations.literal: Again east passes Mount Baiyu, on the right joins the Fuqi River, reaches north of the city.
translations.idiomatic: It ran east past Mount Baiyu, received the Fuqi River on the right, and reached the north of the city.

sentences.zh: 折北，右合盧水，地理志「橫故山，久臺出」。

translations.literal: Turns north, on the right joins the Lu River; Geographic Treatise "Mount Henggu, Jiutai rises."
translations.idiomatic: It turned north, received the Lu River on the right—the Geography Monograph's "Mount Henggu: Jiutai rises there."

translations.literal: The Mi River, passes Mount Ba and enters Gaomi.
translations.idiomatic: The Mi River passed Mount Ba and entered Gaomi.

sentences.zh: 其東五龍河，其西長乾溝，又西浯水自安丘入，逕漢故平昌，合荊水，並從之。

translations.literal: To its east the Wulong River; to its west the Changqian Ditch; farther west the Wu River from Anqiu enters, passes the Han old Pingchang, joins the Jing River, all follow it.
translations.idiomatic: To its east lay the Wulong River and to its west the Changqian Ditch; farther west the Wu River from Anqiu entered, passed the Han-era old site of Pingchang, joined the Jing River, and all followed it.

translations.literal: Xinyang, Longwan, Puqing, and Zhipan towns.
translations.idiomatic: Xinyang, Longwan, Puqing, and Zhipan towns.

translations.literal: Nanxin inspection post.
translations.idiomatic: Nanxin inspection post.

translations.literal: Yaogou courier station.
translations.idiomatic: Yaogou courier station.

translations.literal: Jiaozhou Directly Administered Department: strategic, busy, and difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaozhou Directly Administered Department: rated strategic, commercially busy, and difficult to govern.

translations.literal: Ming: Laizhou, administering two counties.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it belonged to Laizhou and administered two counties.

sentences.zh: 雍正中降，省靈山衛入之。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng period demoted; Lingshan Guard was absorbed into it.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongzheng reign it was demoted, and Lingshan Guard was absorbed into it.

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year of Guangxu, directly administered.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year of Guangxu it was made a directly administered department.

translations.literal: One hundred li west of the provincial seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred li west of the provincial seat.

translations.literal: Still what it administered.
translations.idiomatic: It still administered the same jurisdictions.

translations.literal: To the south: Mount Ai, Mount Zhu, and Kongtong.
translations.idiomatic: To the south stood Mount Ai, Mount Zhu, and Kongtong.

sentences.zh: 東暨南際海，自即墨迤西南為麻灣口。

translations.literal: East and south on the sea border; from Jimo extending southwest to Mawan Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Its eastern and southern bounds met the sea; from Jimo the coast ran southwest to Mawan Mouth.

sentences.zh: 北有膠萊南河，自平度入，西南膠河自諸城入，右合西源望盪山水，逕漢故祝茲，錯復入，逕金梁鄉鎮，漢祓侯國，即東黔陬城。

translations.literal: To the north is the Jiaolai South River, entering from Pingdu; southwest the Jiao River from Zhucheng enters, on the right joins the west source Wangdang Mountain River water, passes the Han old Zhuci, circuitously re-enters, passes Jinliangxiang Town—the Han Fuhou state, namely Eastern Qiansou city.
translations.idiomatic: To the north the Jiaolai South River entered from Pingdu; in the southwest the Jiao River from Zhucheng entered, received the western source of the Wangdang Mountain River on the right, passed the Han-era old site of Zhuci, looped back in, passed Jinliangxiang Town—the Han Fuhou state, that is, Eastern Qiansou.

sentences.zh: 又逕西黔陬，左合周陽河，錯高密，合張奴水復入，逕都濼。

translations.literal: Again passes Western Qiansou, on the left joins the Zhouyang River, circuitously Gaomi, joins the Zhangnu River and re-enters, passes Dulu.
translations.idiomatic: It passed Western Qiansou, received the Zhouyang River on the left, ran circuitously through Gaomi, joined the Zhangnu River and re-entered, and passed Dulu.

sentences.zh: 又東南，右合碧溝，至夾河套，左會沽河。

translations.literal: Again southeast, on the right joins the Bigou, reaches Jiahetao, on the left meets the Gu River.
translations.idiomatic: It ran southeast, received the Bigou on the right, reached Jiahetao, and met the Gu River on the left.

sentences.zh: 又南守風灣、雲溪河、洋水，又南黃山島、淮子口，迤西薛家島、靈山島。

translations.literal: Again south Shoufeng Bay, Yunxi River, and Yang River; again south Huangshan Island and Huaizi Mouth, extending west Xuejia Island and Lingshan Island.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south lay Shoufeng Bay, the Yunxi River, and the Yang River; farther south Huangshan Island and Huaizi Mouth, and running west Xuejia Island and Lingshan Island.

sentences.zh: 其北岸靈山衛，衛北徐山，又西柴湖盪口、湘子門口，至諸城界麻灣、女姑口，外為膠州灣。

translations.literal: On its north shore Lingshan Guard; north of the guard Mount Xu; again west Chaihu Lake Mouth and Xiangzi Gate Mouth, reaching the Zhucheng border Mawan and Nvgu mouths—outside is Jiaozhou Bay.
translations.idiomatic: On its north shore stood Lingshan Guard; north of the guard lay Mount Xu; farther west were Chaihu Lake Mouth and Xiangzi Gate Mouth, to the Zhucheng border at Mawan and Nvgu mouths—with Jiaozhou Bay beyond.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十三年德人租之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Guangxu the Germans leased it.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Guangxu it was leased to Germany.

translations.literal: Towns: Guzhen and Fengmeng.
translations.idiomatic: Towns: Guzhen and Fengmeng.

translations.literal: Xiahe Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Xiahe Stockade.

translations.literal: Lingshan inspection post.
translations.idiomatic: Lingshan inspection post.

translations.literal: Railway.
translations.idiomatic: Railway.

translations.literal: Gaomi: simple.
translations.idiomatic: Gaomi County: rated lightly administered.

translations.literal: One hundred twenty li southwest of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay one hundred twenty li southwest of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the south: Mount Wangzi.
translations.idiomatic: To the south stood Mount Wangzi.

sentences.zh: 膠河自州入，右合張奴水，逕都濼仍入之。

translations.literal: The Jiao River from the department enters, on the right joins the Zhangnu River, passes Dulu and still enters it.
translations.idiomatic: The Jiao River entered from the department, received the Zhangnu River on the right, passed Dulu, and rejoined it.

sentences.zh: 北：膠萊北河自平度緣界。

translations.literal: To the north: the Jiaolai North River from Pingdu along the border.
translations.idiomatic: To the north the Jiaolai North River ran from Pingdu along the border.

translations.literal: Receives the Wulong River and still enters it.
translations.idiomatic: It took in the Wulong River and rejoined it.

translations.literal: Beside it is the Baimai Lake, dried up.
translations.idiomatic: Beside it lay Baimai Lake, now dried up.

sentences.zh: 西南：濰水自諸城入，左合張洋河，左長乾溝，又西北逕礪阜，鄭康成墓在焉。

translations.literal: To the southwest: the Wei River from Zhucheng enters, on the left joins the Zhangyang River and Changqian Ditch on the left, again northwest passes Mount Lifu; Zheng Kangcheng's tomb is there.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest the Wei River entered from Zhucheng, received the Zhangyang River on the left along with the Changqian Ditch, ran northwest past Mount Lifu, where Zheng Kangcheng's tomb stood.

translations.literal: On the left receives the Wu River, enters Anqiu.
translations.idiomatic: It received the Wu River on the left and entered Anqiu.

translations.literal: Railway.
translations.idiomatic: Railway.

translations.literal: Jimo: strategic and busy.
translations.idiomatic: Jimo County: rated strategic and commercially busy.

translations.literal: Two hundred fifty li southeast of the prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: It lay two hundred fifty li southeast of the prefectural seat.

translations.literal: To the southeast: Mount Buqi and Mount Lao.
translations.idiomatic: To the southeast stood Mount Buqi and Mount Lao.

translations.literal: To the southwest: Heavenly Chamber.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest stood Heavenly Chamber.

translations.literal: To the west: High Saddle.
translations.idiomatic: To the west stood High Saddle.

sentences.zh: 東及南際海，東北自萊陽入，為周甿口。

translations.literal: East and south on the sea border; northeast from Laiyang enters, as Zhouweng Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Its eastern and southern bounds met the sea; from the northeast it entered from Laiyang at Zhouweng Mouth.

translations.literal: Within it Mount Ao; the disused guard.
translations.idiomatic: Within lay Mount Ao of the abolished guard.

translations.literal: Extending southeast, Kaolao Island.
translations.idiomatic: Running southeast was Kaolao Island.

translations.literal: Two inspection posts.
translations.idiomatic: It had two inspection posts.

translations.literal: Farther south, Tianheng Island and Weishan Mouth.
translations.idiomatic: Farther south lay Tianheng Island and Weishan Mouth.

sentences.zh: 又西，女姑口匯海口，遠西河入。

translations.literal: Farther west, Nugu Mouth gathers the sea entrance, and the Yuanxi River enters.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west, Nugu Mouth gathered the sea entrance, and the Yuanxi River flowed in.

translations.literal: Beyond it lies Jiao'ao.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond lay Jiao'ao Bay.

translations.literal: Farther west: Chidao Island.
translations.idiomatic: Farther west stood Chidao Island.

translations.literal: To the southwest: Qingdao, reaching the department border.
translations.idiomatic: To the southwest lay Qingdao, extending to the department border.

sentences.zh: 北：孟沙河入平度注姑河。

translations.literal: To the north: the Mengsha River enters Pingdu and flows into the Gu River.
translations.idiomatic: To the north the Mengsha River entered Pingdu and joined the Gu River.

sentences.zh: 姑河復緣界入州，流浩河從之。

translations.literal: The Gu River again follows the border into the department, and the Liuhao River follows it.
translations.idiomatic: The Gu River again followed the border into the department, with the Liuhao River accompanying it.
